statement: Between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-16, a single air or drone strike in Sudan kills at least 50 people.
resolution: True if Reuters, AP, or UN OCHA reports a single air or drone strike in Sudan, occurring between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-16, with a death toll of at least 50 as of the deadline.
failure_condition: No single air or drone strike in Sudan between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-16 kills at least 50 people.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-16, UKMTO records at least one incident in which a merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf is fired upon, struck, or seized.

failure_condition: No merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf is fired upon, struck, or seized between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-16.

statement: The S&P 500 closes below 7300.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 7712.71 on the packet date 2026-10-19.
resolution: True if the S&P 500 official daily close (S&P Dow Jones Indices, FRED series SP500) is below 7300.00 on any trading day from 2026-10-20 through 2026-11-20 inclusive. Reference level: 7712.71 on 2026-10-19.
